source.rule: TAM and SAM are CARRIED, never re-derived. They are asserted equal to the house figure on every run. The account floors are derived FROM the carried dollars, one way only: an account count is never multiplied back into a TAM or SAM figure, because that would restate $1.28B as $1,279,992,000 and $282M as $281,988,000.

reconciliation.item: SOM ARR from the ramp (terminal accounts x ACV)
reconciliation.note: independent of the house SOM: ramp 40 -> 80 -> 120 accounts, so the terminal rung x 14000 ACV = 1680000. Two routes, same figure

120 accounts x $14,000 blended ACV = $1,680,000. Both terms are declared in inputs.json: som_accounts = 120 and blended_acv_usd = 14,000; the product is the house SOM, so the arithmetic is shown rather than asserted

reconciliation.item: SOM ARR as a share of SAM
reconciliation.note: 1,680,000 / 282,000,000 = 0.5957%, quoted as 0.596%. Computed from dollars only - never from an account count, which is why the 20,142 floor residual cannot leak into this ratio
